review_role.independent_product_scope: GI/Geometry integration lifecycle and graph changes, Geometry backend and shader scope inherited from the two exact source reviews.
authored_code_excluded: earlier RenderPipeline, material, shadow and transparency work
review_role.exclusion_note: The current combined RenderPipeline additions were reviewed as an integration delta; this is not an independent review of every inherited renderer implementation.
review_role.tests: Full candidate test outputs and current GPU reports were checked; the reviewer did not rerun the complete C++ suite for this metadata review.

checks: Frame descriptor stride 232 contains disjoint GI [152,184) and geometry [192,232) blocks; history/material ranges begin after all frame blocks.
PrepareGiFrame precedes PrepareGeometryFrame. Any combined preparation failure resets both interfaces to the shared unsubmitted DIRECT list before each pending owner is discarded.

Graphics Execute marks both pending owners executed. A successful queue signal precedes GI Submit and geometry Commit. If the first commit returns failure, the other remains pending/executed and is retired by the destructor after queue Flush.

Destructor flushes the graphics/compute/copy queues before ReleaseGiResources and ReleaseGeometryResources. Executed pending owners receive the completed fence; unsubmitted lists are discarded before cancellation.

Resize flushes and collects all frames, retires geometry size-dependent allocations, then recreates depth/targets/frame contexts. GI logical resources and descriptor heap remain alive. New command-list interfaces and per-frame texture/tint bindings use the same stable GI descriptor blocks.
ResetTemporalHistory invalidates the GI history through its existing CPU reset path.
Shadow writes precede GiTrace. GiRemap writes the new history group before trace; GiUpdate reads the old group and writes the new group; raster receivers read the completed new group.

Geometry upload, depth counter clear/cull, depth draw, per-mip reverse-Z Hi-Z, color counter clear/cull precede indirect GBuffer. The color argument and counter resources are declared IndirectArgument reads.
Transparency reads the current GI group after opaque/volume work. The temporal pass consumes the reactive mask after transparency.
Present returns geometry argument/counter/Hi-Z, GI position/ray/history resources to Common, while depth and shadow resources return to DepthWrite.
All 316 native input hashes and 46 compiled shader hashes match the frozen R1 build after the main-base synchronization.
historical_review_note: The old backend review's one nonmatching GpuGeometry.cpp hash precedes the conservative float-underflow frustum fix. The later FTZ review binds the current GpuGeometry.cpp and shared culling helper. It supersedes only that earlier source hash.
limitations: No blanket independent-source-review claim for all 316 inputs.
ExecuteIndirect changes root CBV bindings; the retained D3D12 warning limits subsequent GPU-validation state tracking. Command readback complements validation, but does not remove that limitation.
Source review and zero validation errors do not establish final visual quality, throughput, or the unfinished M4.4 LOD/streaming/virtual-shadow-page requirements.
